Differences from the antecedent: token 0: 1962 prints "Deus,"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "EUS," (edit distance 1); token 3: 1922 Tours Mame adds "D"; the 1962 has nothing there; token 6: 1962 prints "Genetricis tuae"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "Genitricis tuz" (edit distance 2); token 12: 1962 prints "Ordinem"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "érdinem" (edit distance 1); token 15: 1962 prints "propitius; ut,"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "propitius;ut," (edit distance 0); token 18: 1962 prints "hodie Commemorationem"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "hédie Commemoratidnem" (edit distance 2); token 31: 1922 Tours Mame adds ":"; the 1962 has nothing there; token 33: 1962 prints "et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate."; 1922 Tours Mame reads "Léctio libri Sapiéntix Eecli. 24, © quasi" (edit distance 28, conclusion); 1922 Mame prints Genitricis where the 1962 prints Genetricis; 1922 Mame prints cujus and ejus where the 1962 prints cuius and eius; 1922 Mame prints ordinem in lower case, the 1962 Ordinem; 1922 Mame ends at the short cue Qui vivis., the 1962 writes it out as Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate.. propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatissimae semper Virginis et Genetricis tuae Mariae singulari
titulo Carmeli Ordinem decorasti: concede propitius; ut, cujus hodie
Commemorationem solemni celebramus officio, ejus muniti praesidiis, ad
gaudia sempiterna pervenire mereamur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in
unitate.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Sanctifica, Domine, quaesumus, oblata libamina: et, beatae Dei Genetricis
Mariae saluberrima intercessione, nobis salutaria fore concede. Per eundem
Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Adjuvet nos, quaesumus, Domine, gloriosae tuae Genetricis semperque Virginis
Mariae intercessio veneranda: ut, quos perpetuis cumulavit beneficiis, a
cunctis periculis absolutos, sua faciat pietate Concordes: Qui vivis et
regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate.
